text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I am thrilled to receive so much.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll send the photo displayed in my room to my parents.
Fufu... to tell them I've made more friends.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, with this many,
we won't have room to keep them in our room."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's possible if we rethink the furniture arrangement
and optimize the dead space.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Let us hurry back and measure it with the tape.
...I am itching to get started.
